outlook.statement: The Company expects to see a measurable turnaround in its financial performance, targeting a steady improvement in operating margins and sustainable profit growth over the next three to five financial years.
outlook.period: next three to five financial years

outlook.statement: The ayurveda industries are expected to have a healthy growth in the coming years primarily due to rising demand for natural and herbal products, government support, and increase in adoption. The Company is well-positioned to capitalise on the huge opportunity in the market, consistently investing in manufacturing facilities and marketing activities to strengthen brand awareness. The Company believes its brand, quality products, and domain expertise will help in long term to continue to grow and capture new markets.

Company is structurally well-positioned to capitalize on the Indian Ayurvedic market's secular growth curve. Having built a solid presence across Maharashtra, Karnataka, West Bengal, and Orissa, the Company is actively expanding its geographic footprint into untapped states while deepening its e-commerce reach. Going forward, the Company will focus on investing in its core manufacturing capabilities, scaling targeted brand awareness campaigns, and developing value-added formulations for unmet medical needs.

risks: unexpected inflationary pressures on operational inputs
increased competitive intensity within the industry
Perception of trust deficit in Ayurveda due to lack of awareness and diminished evidence-based quality of treatments
Shortage of trained and qualified Ayurvedic practitioners in India
Lack of vibrant ecosystem for evidence-based research in Ayurveda
Largely unregulated, concerns quality and authenticity of Ayurvedic treatments
Mainstream narrative that Ayurvedic remedies are slow to heal acute or chronic conditions
